instruction.name: xvmod.h
instruction.description: Compute the remainder of each signed 16-bit element in `a` divided by the corresponding element in `b`.

experiments.name: dependent chain with element-0 reset helper
experiments.init: li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr0, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr2, $r4; li.w $r5, 1; li.w $r6, 0
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 500 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr0, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr2, $r4; li.w $r5, 1; li.w $r6, 0' --asm 'xvmod.h $xr0, $xr0, $xr2; xvpickve2gr.w $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr0, $r4'

experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline
experiments.init: li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr0, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr2, $r4; li.w $r5, 1; li.w $r6, 0
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 4000 --iters 500 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr0, $r4; li.w $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr2, $r4; li.w $r5, 1; li.w $r6, 0' --asm 'xvadd.b $xr0, $xr0, $xr0; xvpickve2gr.w $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.h $xr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Calibration experiment (not used for the reported latency).

latencies.notes: 9.99 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 4000, iters 500.
